feature: Customer Portal v2 — Governance / Security / Compliance pillar HERO wiring to real war-room-pillars data (Git #1200). A FOCUSED subset of portal-v2-pillars.json: it exercises only the three heroes this wiring pass touched (score ring, live/fixture source marker, real finding-count tiles, cross-pillar global-admins tile, and the honest 'Not measured yet' gap tiles), so it runs in ~4 page loads rather than the full 227-step suite. The full suite (portal-v2-pillars.json) remains the deployed-server regression; this one is the fast, isolated proof of #1200. NOTE: GET /api/portal/assessment/war-room-pillars is a heavy engine recompute that takes ~90s per call on a LOCAL dev server, so the UI assertions below need a runner element-wait of >=90s to see the real value replace the fixture fallback — on a deployed (fast) server they resolve immediately, exactly as the Licensing/Adoption/Health hero steps already do in the full suite.
notes: HONEST-NULL FALLBACK (Git #1387): the six pillar heroes no longer fall back to the fixture score/delta/status-label/trend-verdict when the real value is null — they render the shared no-scan-data seam (NoScanValue -> muted '—', NO_SCAN_DATA_LABEL) exactly as the Overview strip already did. THIS MANIFEST EXERCISES THE SCORED (dataState='live') CASE ONLY: the testbed Assessment account IS scored (proven by G2/S2/C2 reading 'live'), so the score/status assertions here confirm the REAL value still renders through NoScanValue unchanged. The honest-EMPTY branch ('—' / 'No scan data available') only fires on a genuinely never-scanned tenant, which this harness has no reachable fixture for — that path is verified by tsc + code review, not asserted here, rather than faked against a scored tenant.

THE API TESTS ARE THE REAL CONTRACT. SETUP+A1-A5 exercise GET /api/portal/assessment/war-room-pillars and extract the live per-pillar scores/counts the pages render, so they verify the data layer independent of the UI. pillars[] order is WAR_ROOM_PILLAR_KEYS: governance(0), licensing(1), adoption(2), compliance(3), health(4), security(5), copilot(6).

THE HONEST-GAP ASSERTIONS (G4/S6/S7/C4) prove the STEP-1 audit result renders on the page: a design hero tile with no real producer (Overdue Access Reviews, MFA-coverage %, Secure Score, Retention Coverage) shows 'Not measured yet', never a fabricated number.

STEP 2 (risk heat-map likelihood axis) is intentionally NOT covered here: it stays fixture (no real probability estimate exists) and is flagged as backend-design work, not fabricated — same as portal-v2-pillars.json's own G2c/S11c risk-panel steps.

ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL (the Portal origin, e.g. http://localhost:5175 — its /api proxies to the api-server), TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD, TEST_PORTAL_SLUG.
